transcript.text: Now I have region via customers, and orders has amount/discount/status/order_ts. Revenue policy = amount - discount, completed orders only. Need calendar year 2025 (Jan 1 - Dec 31 2025), joining orders to customers for region.

args.sql:
SELECT c.region, SUM(o.amount - o.discount) AS net_revenue_cents
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
GROUP BY c.region
ORDER BY net_revenue_cents DESC
